d: Process Engineer is responsible for the study of production activities and preparation of proposals for improvements in processes, equipment, devices and methods, correction of manufacturing times for product components and the final product. Researches the best use of labor and raw materials. Analyzes and defines methods and work processes, study times and parameters, maps flow of activities and identifies failures in order to establish strategies to solve problems and propose continuous process improvement. Must have complete Higher Education Course (Production Engineering, Processes, Industrial)

Supports the Engineering Manager in the planning, optimization and implementation of industrial processes, monitoring the flow and performance indexes to identify opportunities for improvements and eliminate failures to achieve the results of volume, quality and cost. Study the productive activities and develop proposals for improvements in processes, equipment, devices and methods, factory layout, correction of product manufacturing times. It studies better ways to use labor, raw materials and other resources in the process. It is responsible for the production parameters, definition of processes, elaboration and development of procedures and work standards, using methods and equipment to elaborate and monitor the production processes.

As a process specialist, you must work extensively on establishing and maintaining the process, promoting product requirements in accordance with ISO 9001: 2015 standards. You must have a good working knowledge of EMS and OSHA requirements.

You must strive to continually improve using Lean tools to reduce costs and improve quality. Act independently at the organizational level. Results reviewed by the head of the organization. Decisions and results have an impact on the role and its success.
q: Chasing innovation in the assembly and manufacturing processes, seeking continuous improvement and the achievement of results

The Senior Residential Marketing Manager is a commercially driven marketing specialist responsible for executing Red Sea Global’s residential marketing strategy across a portfolio of ultra-luxury developments.

This role owns the delivery of integrated marketing programmes designed to build brand equity, generate high-quality, prequalified leads , and directly support sales conversion . A key focus is engaging UHNW and HNW audiences through targeted digital campaigns, premium events, PR, and bespoke content.

Working closely with Sales, Digital, Events and other development Marketing teams - alongside multiple external agencies - this role ensures marketing activities are aligned to commercial objectives and contribute measurably to revenue performance.
This is a hands-on marketing role combining strategic ownership, collaboration and strong execution across the full funnel.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or related discipline.
8+ years’ experience in senior marketing roles, ideally within luxury real estate, development, asset management, branded residences, or premium consumer brands.
Strong experience in CRM-led lead generation and sales-driven marketing.
Demonstrated experience engaging UHNW and HNW audiences.
PR experience and strong understanding of media landscapes.
Proven track record delivering integrated B2C campaigns; B2B experience advantageous.
Highly commercial mindset with strong agency management and leadership skills.
Previous experience in the GCC region strongly preferred, with good understanding of the regional luxury real estate market.
The role may require national and international travel – to assist with events and on-site activities.
r: Lead execution of residential marketing strategies aligned to wider commercial and brand objectives.
Develop asset-level marketing plans, positioning, and audience strategies for particular development.
